decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sharp, sustained cross-axis displacement near the end of the first window (indices 538–544), and (2) an ambiguous multi-sample drop within a high-amplitude oscillatory platform in the final window (indices 705–729). Both show complex morphology with possible superposed or incomplete returns.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt shift in N and E around index 538–540, with N jumping from ~1.2 to ~6.7 and E from ~-1.8 to ~-9.9, while U shifts from ~-1.4 to ~1.0; the change is sustained over several samples and not clearly reversed within the window.

From index ~680 onward, N and E exhibit a prolonged platform-like behavior with high-amplitude oscillations (N ~13–17, E ~-12 to -16), but around index 705–710 there is an ambiguous multi-sample drop in N (~17→13) and E (~-13→-16) that may represent a partial return or superposed offset; the surrounding context suggests possible opposing changes without clear resolution.
